panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Astra starts the required wellness block in the bright but uncomfortably warm multipurpose room, making the no-personal-disclosure boundary explicit.
PANEL 2 — Kreeb tries to enjoy the session while Noola, uncomfortable inside her warming water dome, tells him to enjoy it without involving her.
PANEL 3 — Zib checks the rattling vent behind the blocked service wall as the program continues; Noola adjusts the cooling controls at the edge of the room. Keep the diagnostic action identifiable.
PANEL 4 — Pixa points out the clear exit route while Noola gives a dry approving response, still standing near the door. Astra need not appear in this close exchange.

summary: Wellness Week begins in the overheated multipurpose room while the real ventilation problem continues. Each exchange belongs to the people visibly involved; the exit is available rather than theatrically offered.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Near the multipurpose-room door, Jax offers to stay only if Astra needs a head count. Astra refuses to count a session held in an unsafe room; their two-shot captures the decision.
PANEL 2 — Zib requests full access to the wall as Kreeb begins shifting chairs out of the service hatch's clearance area. Neither needs a crowd watching.
PANEL 3 — Mira takes a baseline temperature reading for comparison after repair, noting the compromised environmental data while Kreeb finishes opening the access path.
PANEL 4 — Jax carries the last chair out of Zib's way as Astra officially ends the wellness block. Jax's exit joke can land over the departing chair.

summary: The failed baseline turns back into a maintenance handoff: Astra refuses a meaningless attendance count, Zib asks for access, Kreeb clears the chairs, Mira plans a post-repair measurement, and Jax helps move furniture rather than pose as a participant.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Later, the multipurpose room is cool again and the program seats are pushed aside. Noola steps in, checks her dome temperature, and acknowledges the comfortable result.
PANEL 2 — Jax retrieves his abandoned coffee and jokes that he preferred sleeping in the warmer room, while the repaired vent runs quietly overhead.
PANEL 3 — Near the service hatch, Zib finishes a normal repair log and answers Jax, who is holding his coffee; both faces and their relationship to the repaired unit are clear.
PANEL 4 — Kreeb refills an ordinary water pitcher and asks Noola whether she intends to stay for any subsequent session. No program official is present.
PANEL 5 — Noola chooses a window-side chair because the room is pleasant, not because of enrollment. Zib closes the final repair check from the doorway in the background.

summary: The repaired multipurpose room returns to useful everyday service without a wellness session. Noola verifies her water-rig comfort, Jax jokes about napping through the repair, Kreeb asks whether anyone is staying, and Noola chooses to remain for herself.
